Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / technical deep dive

Hi Jon —

Thanks again for taking the time today — it was helpful to understand Acme's priority around reducing inference cost and standardizing model serving across teams. Quick recap from my side:

- Current pain: inconsistent latency across deployments, high per-token cost for bursty traffic
- Goals: predictable latency SLA for customer-facing features, lower unit cost, and visibility into model economics
- Tech constraints: SOC2 compliance required, private VPC option for regulated workloads

As discussed, the best next step is a 60-minute technical demo + deep dive where we can:
1) Walk through Redwood's serving runtime and autoscaling for predictable throughput
2) Show routing/fallbacks and quantization recommendations for cost control
3) Discuss integration plan and security controls (VPC/KMS/audit logs)

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed, Mar 18 — 11:00 AM PT
- Thu, Mar 19 — 2:00 PM PT

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will attend? For the deep dive it helps to have an engineering lead and the person who owns infra/networking (if possible).

If neither works, provide a couple of alternative windows and we'll adapt. Once we lock a time I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a short agenda (attached).

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
